messages:
elaine: Heads-up — BigBank's security questionnaire just landed. Main asks: proof of KMS key rotation + chain-of-custody logs, RBAC change history for service accounts, and sample SIEM export for a suspected exfil event. Can we do a short tabletop to prepare artifacts?
sam: yep, +1. when you thinking?
elaine: ideally before EOW. Customer wants examples for the presales packet and a quick walkthrough call next week.
maria: I can pull the audit-log snippets for key rotation and role grants. Quick Q: do they want envelope encryption diagrams for customer-managed keys or just our KMS usage?
elaine: they asked both — CMK flow and Redwood-managed KMS fallback. Need sequence diagrams and logs.
anya: tagging in runbook owners — @ryan can you lead the tabletop?
ryan: I can. suggest agenda: scenario, required artifacts, reproduction of a partial log export, and an ask list for the customer (time window, tenant id). 30–45m?
jon: I'll prepare a scrubbed log export and a sample key-rotation event that matches our audit format. We should show these fields: principal, action, key_id, old_key_version, new_key_version, request_id, timestamp, and related commit id.
maria: sample line: `2025-06-01T14:02:33Z principal=service:tx-ingest action=RotateKey key_id=enc-abc123 old=ver7 new=ver8 request_id=7f3a...` — I'll include a block with redaction instructions.
elaine: good. also include RBAC deltas: who changed role bindings + justification field from the change request.
jon: for RBAC history we have the audit table. Example SQL extract I plan to share: 
```
SELECT actor, target_role, change_type, reason, occurred_at, request_id
FROM rbac_audit
WHERE tenant_id = 'bigbank-prod' AND occurred_at BETWEEN '2025-05-01' AND '2025-06-01';
```
jon: I'll anonymize hostnames and redact PII before sharing.
sec-bot: scheduled runbook reminder: tabletop-security-exercise assigned to ryan at 2025-06-05T15:00Z.
ryan: thanks sec-bot. To prepare evidence for a QSA they'll want chain-of-custody for keys + exported KMS access logs with integrity proof. We can provide: signed log archive (SHA256) + provenance metadata, rotation timeline, and screenshots of KMS console for the event ID.
maria: can we produce the signed archive from our log-collector? I think the archival step currently attaches a checksum but not a signed manifest.
ryan: true — current pipeline does `sha256sum` and stores checksum in object metadata. For enterprise they want a signed manifest. We can GPG-sign the manifest in the export pipeline. I'll add a small task.
tanya: FYI for CMK workflows: customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) is supported on Dedicated and Private only. We'll need to call that out in the response.
elaine: callout noted. we'll be explicit about deployment modes.
sam: incident response angle: customer asked how we detect suspicious key usage (e.g., mass decrypt calls). Can we show a sample alert rule?
jon: sample detection rule: `rate(count_where(action='Decrypt', key_id='enc-abc123'),1m) > 100` -> trigger alert. I'll paste a compact Kibana/ES query.
jon: `{"query": {"bool": {"must": [{"term":{"action":"Decrypt"}},{"term":{"key_id":"enc-abc123"}}],"filter":{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1h"}}}}}}`
ryan: also include a playbook snippet: if alert -> 1) revoke keys (if allowed), 2) enable tighter RBAC, 3) snapshot KV caches, 4) export logs and notify SEC + customer.
maria: one more: customer asked about log retention and tamper-evidence. We keep immutable object storage for 90 days by default and longer on request. Appendix should show SLA and retention config.
elaine: good. I'll draft the questionnaire answers and prod the template attachments. Who will join the customer call?
ryan: I can. jon for logs, maria for KMS specifics, tanya for deployment constraints.
sam: I'll join to answer RBAC and policy questions briefly.
elaine: ok set meeting for 2025-06-06 10:00 PT. Ryan please send calendar invite and prep doc link.
ryan: invite sent. Draft doc here: https://redwood.internal/docs/sec/tabletop-bigbank (internal).
jon: uploading scrubbed logs to secure share now, will post link in channel when done.
maria: I've started a checklist in the drive with artifacts we need: rotation proof, signed manifest, RBAC SQL extract, SIEM sample, playbook snippet, screenshots.
elaine: great. after the call we should capture any follow-up asks as discrete tickets with priority P0/P1 so sales can track.
sam: one quick technical clarifier from the questionnaire: they asked whether our KMS exposes plaintext key material to application VMs. Short answer: no — we only expose ephemeral decrypted material in the hardware enclave/KMS shim and we don't persist plaintext. Include a short diagram.
tanya: and include HSM-backed statement for Private/HSM customers.
elaine: perfect. thanks all — let's reconvene after the call to finalize artifacts for the packet. :thumbsup: 
ryan: noted. will run the signed-manifest PR tomorrow.
jon: logs uploaded: s3://redwood-sec-proof/bigbank/scrubbed/5600000000-logs.tar.gz (link shared privately).
maria: checklist updated, ping me for review.
elaine: thread closed for prep — will reopen if we need more. Thanks!
